treatment_value_integrity.finding: Execution script applied round(float(r['y_pred']), 2) at line 141, truncating high-precision empirical predictions to 2 decimal places instead of passing exact raw CSV floats.
treatment_value_integrity.cause: Stage81ForecastEngine.validate_stage81_solar_metadata enforces a strict 1e-4 tolerance on D3 PV transformation that fails if unrounded floats are passed due to internal 2-decimal rounding of solar_gen_pts.

horizon_semantics.finding: Treatment MPC loop sliced single 24-step prediction vector (o_rows[step_k:]) and zero-padded trailing hours (up to 23 trailing zeros at step 23), whereas Control generated a fresh full 24-hour forecast at every step.

protocol_semantics_audit.question_A: The frozen empirical artifact was intended to provide a single 24-hour forecast issued at origin t0 for the 24-hour replay horizon.
protocol_semantics_audit.question_B: Intermediate MPC timesteps in a 24-hour receding horizon simulation require 24-hour forecasts starting at t_k, which are not present in the origin-level CSV.
protocol_semantics_audit.question_C: The frozen prediction artifact contains predictions ONLY for origin t0 and does NOT contain sub-origin predictions for t0+k.
protocol_semantics_audit.question_D: Zero-padding (0.0 W/m2) does NOT represent an authorized Stage8.1 model prediction.
protocol_semantics_audit.question_E: Zero-padding and shrinking the forecast horizon for Treatment while giving Control a full 24h forecast introduces a massive structural confound favoring Control.

future_truth_firewall.finding: Future ground truth (y_true) was fetched after optimization and passed strictly to simulator/evaluator.

raw_evidence_audit.finding: RAW.csv preserves origin-level summary endpoints but does NOT preserve step-level injected forecast arrays or step-level dispatch plans.

result_validity.finding: The reported fuel difference (+5.91 L/origin, p=1.86e-3) is confounded by the zero-padding shrinking-horizon defect in Treatment MPC execution.

reproducibility_audit.full_experiment_reproducibility_claim: MISLABELED — Seed=42 applies strictly to bootstrap resampling, not full physical MPC replay determinism.

protocol_hash_audit.finding: PROTOCOL_HASH field reported treatment prediction artifact SHA-256 (a4d288f9...) instead of protocol document hash.

identified_deviations: DEVIATION_1: 2-decimal rounding of empirical treatment prediction values (round(float(r['y_pred']), 2)).
DEVIATION_2: Slicing and zero-padding treatment forecast horizon (o_rows[step_k:] + zero-padding) in MPC loop.
DEVIATION_3: Asymmetric horizon semantics between Treatment (shrinking/zero-padded) and Control (full 24h diurnal).
DEVIATION_4: Protocol hash field mislabeled with dataset SHA-256.
DEVIATION_5: Seed=42 mischaracterized as full experiment determinism proof.
final_governance_classification: B — EXECUTION COMPLETED BUT HAS GOVERNED/RELEVANT DEVIATIONS REQUIRING CORRECTION BEFORE SCIENTIFIC INTERPRETATION
next_governed_step: Submit formal correction plan to align MPC replay horizon architecture with frozen Stage8.1 prediction artifact structure before executing a valid replay.
